name: flow/ui-focus-zoom
title: UI focus zoom
title_vi: Camera phóng vào một vùng giao diện
desc_vi: Màn hình ứng dụng hiện ra một nhịp, rồi camera phóng to và lia tới vùng được chọn và giữ nguyên; một quầng sáng nở ra tại điểm nhấn khi camera tới.
params_vi: anchorX, anchorY: điểm nhấn, % từ mép trái / trên (64, 36) · zoom: độ phóng (1 - 3) · zoomAt: giây camera xuất phát (1.4) · halo: bật quầng sáng · image: ảnh màn hình (rỗng = màn khung xương) · accent: màu nhấn · exit: none | fade | up · duration: độ dài gốc 4.5 s · bg, base, fg, surface, border, shadow: màu · radius: bo góc (px, 0 = mặc định)
notes: Camera law, clamp, envelope and eases as in the source (world wrapper transform translate(x %, y %) scale(S) with T = -(anchor - 50) x S clamped to 50 (S - 1) - 0.36; settle 0.9 s power3.out with rise 4.5 cqh and scale 0.965 -> 1 around 50 % 60 %; camera 1.1 s power2.inOut at zoomAt clamped inside [IN, D - OUT - move - 0.05]; halo 0.75 s power2.out from the middle of the camera move, 0.55 -> 1 scale, 0 -> 0.85 opacity; exit fade / up 0.5 s; phases shrink together when the duration is short). The camera was a proxy object repainted by an onUpdate writer; it is one ordinary tween on the world wrapper (scale, xPercent, yPercent = the same translate(%) scale(S) matrix), so the film has plain keyframes. DROPPED: the micro-drift (sine cycles of 0.16 % and 0.11 % of the frame, i.e. 0.3 px and 0.12 px at 1920 x 1080, ending at exactly zero): it is invisible and would turn the whole preset into per-frame code; the pan clamp keeps its 0.16 + 0.2 margin so the camera targets are identical. cqw / cqh / cqmin are taken from the target box (custom property --cm holds one percent of its short side; the source demo mounted it in a 72 % x 64 % card, as the gallery demo does). The surface is the source's token-styled skeleton app (header bar, sidebar, three cards) unless `image` is set (source: a slot template; a direct img is covered); in the source the second header line never got a width (nth-of-type counted the mark span) and so was invisible, only the first line (6.5 cqmin) is drawn. Source variables: anchor_x / anchor_y / zoom / zoom_at / halo / exit kept (halo as true / false); accent is a hex colour (source: green / blue / violet reading theme tokens); theme tokens became params with the source fallbacks (fg #f8fafc, surface #0b1016, border #475569, bg transparent, base #05070c for the mixes). color-mix() is written as rgba / computed hex. The root takes the radius of its target (border-radius: inherit).
